title.rendered: UCSF Holiday December 2013 SF Presidio Golden Gate Club

content.rendered:
12/13/13 (Friday), 6-10pm in the Presidio Golden Gate Club.

Country and Western Theme. Staff & Family Fun.

DJ and Photo Booth.
Photo Booth – cowboys hats, mustaches,  sheriff star/badge, bandanas, cowboy vest.

Line Dancing.
